text: Your train is running four hours late, and the trip no longer works.
Railway refund rules say: if a train runs more than three hours late and you don't travel,
you can claim the full fare, with no cancellation charge.
The catch: don't just press cancel. An hour before departure, that can return nothing.
Instead, file a TDR online for the late train, before it actually leaves.
